title: Reports ON grants Reports page access with all reports (no per-report granularity)
expected: Reports top-nav item present; Reports page opens listing all reports with no per-report gating
actual: With reportsPageAccess ON, 'Reports' appears in top nav (link /reports). /reports opened showing full report list: Timesheet Activities, Sales, Technician Efficiency, Advisor Analysis, Shop Efficiency, Sales Tax Collected, IBS Batches, QB Unexported, Notes, Reminders — all present, none gated per-report
reason: Reports page access granted with complete report list as specified

title: Reports OFF hides the top nav Reports item
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST custom role as Tech (workOrdersView only)
expected: No Reports item in top nav when reportsPageAccess OFF
actual: With reportsPageAccess OFF (workOrdersView-only role), top nav shows only Work Orders + notifications; no Reports item, no /reports link
reason: Reports nav hidden when permission off; confirmed against ON-state contrast
